summary: This is an 18-unit historic apartment building located at 13 Newfound St., Canton, NC, built in 1930 and offering 14,646 SF of rentable space on a 0.19-acre lot. The property is marketed at a 7.25% cap rate with a $2,600,000 asking price, and features a mix of studio, one, and two-bedroom units. It is fully occupied with a wait list and is situated in downtown Canton, close to shops, restaurants, and major highways.
